experiment: E1.5.1 deterministic received power and SNR: 5G-LENA v5.1 vs the Python link budget
status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-07, committed before the first run; values, checks and tolerances are not changed after results are seen
protocol: docs/E1_5_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md section 4, E1.5.1 (acceptance criteria V1-V5 fixed there before this config)

stack.program: ns3/scratch/cmwave/e15-link-validation.cc (installed copy SHA-256 must equal the repo copy)

channel: MatrixPropagationLossModel with the prescribed loss per gNB-UE pair (symmetric), no ns-3 path loss, no shadowing, no fast fading, no building loss, no interference (single cell); isotropic 1x1 antennas at both ends

common.rb_overhead_reason: floor(20e6 x (1 - 0.073) / 360e3) = floor(51.5) = 51 RBs (TS 38.101-1 Table 5.3.2-1); the NR default 0.04 gives 53

ues.links: the 27 E1.2 links at their median loss (pathloss_db, zero shadowing) for the run's carrier

python_reference.dl_snr_db: cmwave.radio.link_budget.downlink(L, cfg)['snr_db'] with cfg = 20 MHz, 51 PRB, 44 dBm, NF_UE 7 dB, gains 0
python_reference.ul_snr_db: 23 - L - (-174 + 10 log10(n x 360 kHz) + 5), n = RBs assigned to the TB (m_rbAssignedNum)
python_reference.ns3_sinr_db: 10 log10(m_sinr), m_sinr = linear mean over the TB's RBs (NR TransportBlockInfo::UpdatePerceivedSinr)

acceptance.V0_readback: RB count, gNB power and both noise figures read back from the ns-3 objects equal the configured values; UE TxPower attribute equals 23 dBm
acceptance.V1_dl_snr: every DL data TB of every UE: |10 log10(m_sinr) - DL SNR_python| <= 0.01 dB
acceptance.V2_ul_snr: every UL data TB: |10 log10(m_sinr) - UL SNR_python(n = m_rbAssignedNum)| <= 0.01 dB
acceptance.V3_rb_count: ns-3 RB count = 51 at gNB and UE
acceptance.V4_dl_rx_power: for every UE with DL data: min and max received power per RB (RxDataTrace) within 0.01 dB of 44 - 10 log10(51) - L
acceptance.V5_coverage: every UE whose Python DL SNR >= -5 dB has >= 10 DL TBs, and every UE whose Python 1-PRB UL SNR >= -5 dB has >= 10 UL TBs, in every run; UEs below are reported, not dropped
acceptance.all_runs: V0-V5 must hold in all four runs

reported_not_tested: MCS, TB size, corrupt flag and TBLER per TB; RB-allocation histogram; DL/UL TB counts per UE (inputs to E1.5.3)
